The next species is the Guest. Guests are white-skinned Robloxians who have a bald square head. They wear a black long-sleeve shirt that has a white "ROBLOX" text in the center of it, with the text going onto the arms of the shirt. They wear black leggings with no shoes. Guests also have an identical female variant, except for the fact that female Guests have pink hair tied back in a bun.

The last and rarest species is the Noob. Noobs are yellow Robloxians that have a bald yellow square head, wear a blue sleeveless shirt, and wear green leggings.
